working_policy_decisions.rule: Keep two actual lower-front corners with image-X ordering. Use v=2 only when reliably locatable and canonical 0 0 0 otherwise; preserve a locatable partner.

Use the axis-aligned extent of the observed front face, clipped to the image. Do not infer hidden outer limits; top/tray/rack/hand surfaces do not define the target bounds. The rectangle may contain background or an occluder between visible front fragments.
working_policy_decisions.attribution: Grounded in historical visible-front instructions; detailed occlusion/surface exclusions are local clarification under the user's present authorization, not a supervisor quotation.

working_policy_decisions.rule: Retain a uniquely identifiable front with annotatable visible extent even when both lower corners are unlocatable. Both-v0 status is not a deletion rule.
working_policy_decisions.attribution: Local semantic inclusion decision, supported by representability and published examples; not inferred supervisor intent.

working_policy_decisions.rule: Keep uncertain identity/extent cases in review; do not guess hidden instances or silently turn unresolved annotations into background negatives. No arbitrary visible-area percentage is imposed.
working_policy_decisions.attribution: Local ambiguity-handling rule; no normative area threshold found upstream.

working_policy_decisions.rule: Represent each physical front once; establish duplicate identity from original images, not merely high box IoU or missing-point flags.
working_policy_decisions.attribution: Local semantic deduplication rule; historical exact-box rejection alone does not establish physical identity.
